tools.name: validate_vin
tools.description: Quickly validate a VIN without calling any external APIs.

tools.name: lookup_recalls
tools.description: Look up recalls for a vehicle. Provide either a VIN or make/model/year.

tools.name: batch_decode
tools.description: Decode multiple VINs at once (up to 50).

tools.name: explore_capabilities
tools.description: Discover supported features and explicit coverage gaps.

tools.name: vehicle_catalog
tools.description: Browse EPA year, make, model and configuration menus. Not sale listings.

tools.name: epa_vehicle
tools.description: Get an explicitly selected EPA test configuration; not an exact VIN match.

tools.name: vehicle_emissions
tools.description: Get EPA emissions for an explicit EPA vehicle ID.

tools.name: fuel_price_assumptions
tools.description: EPA fuel-price assumptions, not local station prices.

tools.name: owner_reported_mpg
tools.description: Voluntary owner-reported MPG for an EPA configuration, including sample size and limitations.

tools.name: defect_investigations
tools.description: Search NHTSA model-year defect investigations with retained source variants and snapshot dates.

tools.name: auto_loan_benchmarks
tools.description: Dated Federal Reserve new-car loan benchmark snapshot, not personalized or live loan rates.

tools.name: vehicle_dimensions
tools.description: Canadian model-variant dimensions in cm and kg. Not VIN-specific.

tools.name: manufacturer_communications
tools.description: Search indexed NHTSA communications, with source coverage. Bulletins are not recalls.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Compare 2–4 distinct VINs without treating missing data as zero or counts as safety rankings.

tools.name: ownership_scenario
tools.description: Calculate fixed-rate payments and optional ownership costs from explicit assumptions; not lender or tax quotes.

tools.name: list_saved_vins
tools.description: List VINs saved by a user. Requires a user_token from /api/auth/login.

tools.name: save_vin
tools.description: Save a VIN to a user's collection with an optional label.

tools.name: remove_saved_vin
tools.description: Remove a VIN from the user's saved collection.

tools.name: get_output_preferences
tools.description: Get the user's VIN report output preferences.

tools.name: update_output_preferences
tools.description: Update which sections appear in VIN reports.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "decode_vin" is 1401 chars, far longer than this server's median (71). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "decode_vin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
